meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写网络小说时自动匹配趁手工具,并记住你的写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在写网络小说,希望工具顺着你的习惯走
copy.tagline_en: Auto-match the right writing tools and remember your habits as you draft web novels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want tools that adapt to your habits

howto.what: Claude 会变成网文工具箱的路由入口:把「写小说」「拆文」「扫榜」「去 AI 味」这类请求分发到对应的子技能,还能管理你的写作习惯、启动本地 Dashboard、检查版本更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、$story、/网文 等入口,或说「我想写小说」「打开工作台」这类话时接管;没说明长篇还是短篇时会先反问。

say.note: 先问长篇还是短篇,再路由

say.text: 拆一下这本书的黄金三章

say.note: 启动本地 Dashboard 并返回地址

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the router for a web-novel toolkit: it sends requests like "write a novel", "break down this book", or "scan rankings" to the matching sub-skill, and can manage writing habits or launch a local dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter /story, $story or /网文, or say things like "I want to write a novel" or "open the dashboard"; if long or short form isn't stated, it asks first.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: It asks long or short form, then routes

say_en.text: Break down this book's golden three chapters
say_en.note: Routes to the long-form analysis skill
Starts the local dashboard and returns its URL
